title: Kompaniyasidan ketgan asoschi 12 yildan keyin...

scenes.text: 1985 yilda 30 yoshli asoschi o'zi tuzgan kompaniyada asosiy vakolatlaridan mahrum bo'lib, o'zi ketdi.
U yangi kompaniya ochdi. Uning kompyuterlari qimmat edi va kam sotildi.
1996 yil oxirida eski kompaniyasi o'sha yangi firmani sotib olishini e'lon qildi. Narxi taxminan 430 million dollar.
Bu odam Stiv Jobs edi, kompaniya esa Apple. 1997 yilda u Apple'ni yana boshqara boshladi.
Yangi firmada yozilgan dastur keyin Mac kompyuterlarining asosiga aylandi. Ketish oxiri emas edi.

description:
Stiv Jobs 1985 yilda Apple'dagi asosiy vakolatlaridan mahrum bo'lib, kompaniyadan ketdi va NeXT kompaniyasini ochdi. 1996 yil dekabrida Apple NeXT'ni taxminan 430 million dollarga sotib olishini e'lon qildi, 1997 yilda Jobs Apple'ni yana boshqara boshladi. NeXTSTEP keyin Mac OS X'ning asosi bo'ldi.

Siz ham bir marta ketib, keyin qaytganmisiz? Izohda yozing.
source: Web fact-check 2026-11-20 (web search summaries; Wikipedia and several hosts could not be opened from this session). Computer History Museum (computerhistory.org: NeXT, Apple bought NeXT for $429 million in cash and 1.5 million shares; Jobs ousted as chairman in a boardroom coup 1985); Computing History UK and Cult of Mac (Apple announced the NeXT purchase 20 Dec 1996, closed 7 Feb 1997); Wikipedia NeXT (about $427 million, hence 'taxminan 430 million'); TechRadar (NeXT founded Sept 1985); Jobs interim CEO 1997, permanent 2000. Wording softened from 'chiqarilgan' (Jobs lost operating duties and resigned in Sept 1985).
